golden.claim: You are in your Rising Chapter, in a Magistrate decade.

parts.text: Your Early Chapter was an orderly one, with money counted at home and promises kept in front of you. You came out of it careful, and the habits you formed then still run your accounts.
Inside it ran a steady supply of comfort, good food and someone who made sure you were fed. You still trust that early ease, and you go back to it whenever life runs thin.

decades.label: A Sage decade · 2003 to 2012 · weighs
decades.text: These years gave you more looking after than you needed, and you learned to wait for permission before you moved.

parts.text: Your Rising Chapter is the one where you prove yourself alone. Since your late teens you have taken whole jobs and signed your name to them, and you trust what you carried yourself more than anything you were handed.
Beneath it runs a private education in things nobody asked you to learn. You are gathering the strange and specialist knowledge your later work is paid for, and you rarely explain it to anyone.

decades.label: An Alchemist decade · 2013 to 2022 · weighs
decades.text: These years kept you studying and second-guessing longer than your friends, and you came out of them knowing more than you could yet use.

decades.label: Now · a Magistrate decade · 2023 to 2032 · helping
decades.text: This decade gives your life a structure it did not have before, a clear role and people who rely on you to keep it. You take on more responsibility than you planned, and it steadies you more than it weighs on you.

parts.text: Your Home Chapter opens wider than the ones before it, through a partner whose world is bigger than yours. From your mid-thirties your days fill with new people, side ventures and offers you did not go looking for. You will say yes more often in this chapter than in any other, and most of those yeses pay you back.

decades.label: A General decade · 2033 to 2042 · helping
decades.text: This decade brings pressure you can use, a hard deadline or a rival or a role with stakes, and you rise further under it than in any easy stretch.

parts.text: Your Late Chapter is the well-kept one, when the care of every earlier decade finally shows. From your late forties your days run on order and calm, and you are the person others call when something needs sorting out.
Behind it, the people after you push against you and stand up for you in the same breath. You hold your own place in these years only where you fixed its size early.

decades.label: A Steward decade · 2043 to 2052 · helping
decades.text: This decade rewards patience with steady returns, and you build the kind of security that lets you stop counting.

decades.label: A Horizon decade · 2053 to 2062 · helping
decades.text: This decade opens side roads and second ventures, and you find money and company in places you had never looked.

decades.label: A Virtuoso decade · 2063 to 2072 · helping
decades.text: This decade gives your voice back its edge, and you say what you think with more freedom than you allowed yourself before.

years.text: A hard test arrives from outside, a demanding boss or a rival or a deadline you did not set. You meet it better than you expect, and people remember how you handled it.

bond.text: You make a decision about home or partnership this year that you have been circling for a while.

years.text: A role with your name on it arrives, a promotion or a title or a formal promise. You accept more responsibility than you planned, and you are steadier for it by the end.
Your attention turns inward, toward study and second thoughts and plans you keep to yourself. You get less done than you meant to, and you understand more at the end than at the start.

bond.label: Clashes with your Day Gate · 寅申
bond.text: You change something at home this year, an address or the way you share your life with a partner.

years.text: Help and advice arrive in larger amounts than you asked for, from a teacher or an older ally. You lean on them longer than you need to, and you finish knowing which help to keep.

bond.label: Binds with your Month Gate · 辰酉
bond.text: You tie yourself to a workplace or a team this year more firmly than before, by contract or by loyalty.

years.text: Your life fills with equals, a new colleague or a friend who wants exactly what you want. You compete more than you admit, and you come out of it more set in your own way.

bond.label: Clashes with your Month Gate · 辰戌
bond.text: You leave a role or a team you have outgrown this year, by your own choice or by theirs.

years.text: Someone arrives who wants a share of what you have, at work or among friends. You give ground on money or credit before you notice, and you hold the rest only by being blunt.

bond.label: Binds with your Day Gate · 寅亥
bond.text: You draw a partner or a household closer this year, and the life you share takes on a firmer shape.

years.text: Your appetite comes back, for good food and for the work you enjoy making. Your work gets easier and better liked, and you finish with something you made that people keep.

bond.label: Joins your Month Gate · 子辰
bond.text: You gather people and momentum around one idea at work this year, and it carries further than you planned.
